statement: The standard normal density has the usual normalized exponential formula.
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: Every finite point has strictly positive Gaussian density.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : ℝ) : 0 < φ x
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The standard normal density is integrable.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: : Integrable φ
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The Gaussian density has derivative minus its argument times the density.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt φ (-x * φ x) x
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The Mathlib CDF is the Gaussian density integral over the left half-line.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : ℝ) : Φ x = ∫ t in Iic x, φ t
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The Gaussian CDF has the standard normal density as its derivative.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt Φ (φ x) x
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The Gaussian CDF is continuous.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: : Continuous Φ
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The Gaussian CDF is strictly increasing.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: : StrictMono Φ
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The Gaussian CDF is strictly positive at every finite argument.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : ℝ) : 0 < Φ x
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The Gaussian CDF is strictly less than one at every finite argument.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : ℝ) : Φ x < 1
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The Gaussian CDF tends to zero at negative infinity.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: : Tendsto Φ atBot (𝓝 0)
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The Gaussian CDF tends to one at positive infinity.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: : Tendsto Φ atTop (𝓝 1)
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The scaled negative Gaussian tail tends to the standard normal density at zero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: : Tendsto (fun y ↦ y * exp (y ^ 2 / 2) * Φ (-y)) atTop (𝓝 (1 / sqrt (2 * π)))
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: Reflection takes the Gaussian CDF to its complement.
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The Gaussian CDF at zero is one half.
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The Gaussian density plus the argument times the CDF is strictly positive.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : ℝ) : 0 < φ x + x * Φ x
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: The logarithm of the Gaussian CDF is strictly concave.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: : StrictConcaveOn ℝ univ (fun x ↦ log (Φ x))
dossier_scope_note: Unconditional auxiliary fact about Mathlib standard Gaussian measure, used across the face and fit results.

statement: Strict coverage gives the unattained uniform likelihood envelope.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} {a m : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hx : ∀ i, |x i - m| < a) : IsLUB (likelihood x a m '' Ioi 0) ((1 / (2 * a)) ^ n) ∧ ∀ m' s : ℝ, 0 < s → likelihood x a m' s < (1 / (2 * a)) ^ n
dossier_scope_note: Strict coverage. The equality case uses coverage_uniform_envelope.

statement: At a held centre, every tied endpoint contributes one half to the uniform trace. Every strictly covered observation contributes the full uniform density.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℝ} {a m : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hx : ∀ i, |x i - m| ≤ a) : Tendsto (likelihood x a m) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∏ i, ((if |x i - m| = a then 1/2 else 1) / (2*a))))

statement: Holding a positive Gaussian scale guarantees attainment, including at the zero-width normal seam.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : ∃ p ∈ (Ici 0 ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)), IsMaxOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2 s) (Ici 0 ×ˢ univ) p

statement: With both Gaussian scale and centre held, the maximum over nonnegative width is attained.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : ∃ a ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn (fun w ↦ likelihood x w m s) (Ici 0) a

statement: At positive held width, any compatible centre gives the uniform envelope by maximizing the joint complementary endpoint trace. No finite fit reaches the envelope.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hx : ∀ i, |x i - c| ≤ a) : ∃ w ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, IsMaxOn (uniformTrace x a c) (Icc 0 1) w ∧ IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x a p.1 p.2) '' (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0)) (uniformTrace x a c w) ∧ ∀ m s : ℝ, 0 < s → likelihood x a m s < uniformTrace x a c w
dossier_scope_note: At range equality the theorem optimizes the joint trace over a shared complementary endpoint weight.

statement: At held positive width, a finite maximum exists exactly when the sample range exceeds twice that width. The nonattainment direction includes equality.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : (∃ p ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)), IsMaxOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x a p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) p) ↔ ∃ i j, 2*a < x j - x i
dossier_scope_note: The range test is written as the existence of an observed pair separated by more than twice the held width.

statement: The attained zero-width seam makes the actual constant-sample likelihood unbounded on a nonempty sample.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (m : ℝ) : ¬ BddAbove (likelihood (fun _ : Fin n ↦ m) 0 m '' Ioi 0)

statement: At fixed finite slant, every nonconstant sample has exactly one location–scale MLE for the Mathlib Gaussian skew density.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℝ} (hx : LocationScale.Nonconstant x) (α : ℝ) : ∃! p, p ∈ LocationScale.domain ∧ IsMaxOn (logLik α x) LocationScale.domain p

statement: A constant sample has unbounded log likelihood at every fixed finite slant.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (α : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (m : ℝ) : ¬ BddAbove (logLik α (fun _ : Fin n ↦ m) '' LocationScale.domain)

statement: With location and scale held, the right half-normal limit retains a factor one half at each observation exactly at the location.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ) {ω : ℝ} (hω : 0 < ω) : Tendsto (fun α : ℝ ↦ ∏ i, density α ξ ω (x i)) atTop (𝓝 (∏ i, (2 * φ ((x i - ξ)/ω) / ω) * (if ξ < x i then 1 else if x i < ξ then 0 else 1/2)))

statement: A right half-normal face at an endpoint at or below the sample is reachable without endpoint penalties by moving the location from outside.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {c ω : ℝ} (hω : 0 < ω) (hx : ∀ i, c ≤ x i) : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ ∏ i, density (t^2) (c-t⁻¹) ω (x i)) atTop (𝓝 (halfNormalEnvelope x c ω))

statement: A left half-normal face is reachable from outside the sample by the reflected path.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {c ω : ℝ} (hω : 0 < ω) (hx : ∀ i, x i ≤ c) : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ ∏ i, density (-(t^2)) (c+t⁻¹) ω (x i)) atTop (𝓝 (halfNormalEnvelope x c ω))

statement: Along any feasible location–scale path converging to a positive-scale endpoint, the unpenalized half-normal product bounds the limiting likelihood from above, uniformly over slants.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {c ω : ℝ} (hω : 0 < ω) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {p : ι → ℝ × ℝ} (hp : Tendsto p l (𝓝 (c, ω))) (α : ι → ℝ) {b : ℝ} (hb : halfNormalEnvelope x c ω < b) : ∀ᶠ i in l, (∏ j, density (α i) (p i).1 (p i).2 (x j)) < b
dossier_scope_note: Local upper bound along converging location and positive scale. Global profile confinement is separate.

statement: With rate and location held, the scale-zero path has half the translated-exponential density at the endpoint.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (rate μ x : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun σ ↦ density rate μ σ x) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (rate * exp (-rate * (x - μ)) * (if μ < x then 1 else if x < μ then 0 else 1/2)))

statement: With Gaussian location and positive scale held, infinite rate gives the normal density at that location and scale.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (μ x : ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : Tendsto (fun rate ↦ density rate μ σ x) atTop (𝓝 (φ ((x - μ)/σ) / σ))

statement: A positive held rate and normal scale leave a unique finite location fit on every nonempty sample.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {rate σ : ℝ} (hr : 0 < rate) (hσ : 0 < σ) : ∃! μ, IsMaxOn (locationLogLik x rate σ) univ μ

statement: With location held weakly above an observation, every finite rate gives a smaller density than the corresponding fixed-scale normal limit.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {rate σ μ x : ℝ} (hr : 0 < rate) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hx : x ≤ μ) : density rate μ σ x < φ ((x-μ)/σ) / σ

statement: With location at or above all observations and scale fixed, the normal likelihood is the unattained rate-profile supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {μ σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hx : ∀ i, x i ≤ μ) : IsLUB ((fun rate : ℝ ↦ ∏ i, density rate μ σ (x i)) '' Ioi 0) (∏ i, φ ((x i-μ)/σ)/σ) ∧ ∀ rate > 0, (∏ i, density rate μ σ (x i)) < ∏ i, φ ((x i-μ)/σ)/σ

statement: At a constant sample's held location, with positive rate held, the density supremum over scale is half the rate and is unattained.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {rate : ℝ} (hr : 0 < rate) (m : ℝ) : IsLUB ((fun σ ↦ density rate m σ m) '' Ioi 0) (rate/2) ∧ ∀ σ > 0, density rate m σ m < rate/2

statement: For constant data and held positive rate, varying location and scale approaches the exponential peak, which no finite fit reaches.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {rate : ℝ} (hr : 0 < rate) (m : ℝ) : IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ density rate p.1 p.2 m) '' (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0)) rate ∧ ∀ μ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → density rate μ σ m < rate

statement: At a constant observation a fixed dimensionless shape and shrinking Gaussian scale yield an unbounded density. The path holds location fixed.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (m : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun σ ↦ density σ⁻¹ m σ m) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop

statement: At the held common observation, the all-free rate and scale path makes the likelihood unbounded for every nonempty constant sample.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (m : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun σ ↦ ∏ _ : Fin n, density σ⁻¹ m σ m) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop

statement: The Gaussian peak strictly bounds every finite EMG density at a held Gaussian scale.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {rate μ σ x : ℝ} (hr : 0 < rate) (hσ : 0 < σ) : density rate μ σ x < φ 0 / σ

statement: For a constant sample and held Gaussian scale, the normal peak is the unattained supremum over location and rate, stated per observation.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (m : ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ density p.2 p.1 σ m) '' (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0)) (φ 0/σ) ∧ ∀ μ rate : ℝ, 0 < rate → density rate μ σ m < φ 0/σ

statement: When every observation is at or below a held location, raising the rate toward the normal face improves on any finite rate, even if scale is free.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, x i ≤ μ) : ¬ ∃ p ∈ (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)), IsMaxOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ i, density p.1 μ p.2 (x i)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0) p

statement: With rate and location held, Gaussian scale is attained exactly when some finite positive scale reaches the exponential face trace.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {rate μ : ℝ} (hr : 0 < rate) : (∃ σ ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn (fun s ↦ ∏ i, density rate μ s (x i)) (Ioi 0) σ) ↔ ∃ σ > 0, exponentialTrace x rate μ ≤ ∏ i, density rate μ σ (x i)
dossier_scope_note: Scalar face comparison includes the exact half weight at a held endpoint.

statement: If the held rate is positive and the held location is strictly below the sample, an interior scale exceeds the exponential face and a maximum exists.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {rate μ : ℝ} (hr : 0 < rate) (hx : ∀ i, μ < x i) : ∃ σ ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn (fun s ↦ ∏ i, density rate μ s (x i)) (Ioi 0) σ

statement: If an observation lies to the left of the held location, the exponential face vanishes and a positive scale attains the maximum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {rate μ : ℝ} (hr : 0 < rate) {i : Fin n} (hi : x i < μ) : ∃ σ ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn (fun s ↦ ∏ j, density rate μ s (x j)) (Ioi 0) σ

statement: With location and Gaussian scale held, a finite rate attains the maximum exactly when it reaches the fixed normal face value.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {μ σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : (∃ rate ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn (fun r ↦ ∏ i, density r μ σ (x i)) (Ioi 0) rate) ↔ ∃ rate > 0, (∏ i, φ ((x i-μ)/σ)/σ) ≤ ∏ i, density rate μ σ (x i)

statement: With Gaussian scale held, a finite location and rate fit exists exactly when some finite point reaches the optimized Gaussian face.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : (∃ p ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)), IsMaxOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ i, density p.2 p.1 σ (x i)) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) p) ↔ ∃ μ rate : ℝ, 0 < rate ∧ sSup (range (fun m ↦ normalTrace x m σ)) ≤ ∏ i, density rate μ σ (x i)
dossier_scope_note: Exact finite-witness criterion including equality with the optimized Gaussian face.

statement: At held positive rate and free location and scale, the translated exponential face is attained as a limit at the sample minimum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, c ≤ x i) (rate : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ ∏ i, density rate (c-t⁻¹) ((t⁻¹)^2) (x i)) atTop (𝓝 (∏ i, rate*exp (-rate*(x i-c))))

statement: At held positive rate, a finite fit exists exactly when a finite location and scale reach the optimized translated-exponential face.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hi : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) {rate : ℝ} (hr : 0 < rate) : (∃ p ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)), IsMaxOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ j, density rate p.1 p.2 (x j)) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) p) ↔ ∃ μ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ (∏ j, rate*exp (-rate*(x j-x i))) ≤ ∏ j, density rate μ s (x j)
dossier_scope_note: Exact finite-witness criterion including equality with the translated-exponential face at the sample minimum.

statement: For a held location with a nonzero residual, finite attainment is equivalent to a finite point reaching both optimized conditional faces.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hi : x i ≠ μ) : (∃ p ∈ (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)), IsMaxOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ j, density p.1 μ p.2 (x j)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0) p) ↔ ∃ rate s : ℝ, 0 < rate ∧ 0 < s ∧ max (sSup (normalTrace x μ '' Ioi 0)) (sSup ((fun r ↦ exponentialTrace x r μ) '' Ioi 0)) ≤ ∏ j, density rate μ s (x j)
dossier_scope_note: At least one residual is nonzero. The all-zero case follows from constant_sample_unbounded at the held centre.

statement: For a nonconstant sample every fixed positive dimensionless shape has a unique finite location and scale optimizer.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℝ} (hx : LocationScale.Nonconstant x) {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) : ∃! p, p ∈ LocationScale.domain ∧ IsMaxOn (shapeLogLik x k) LocationScale.domain p
dossier_scope_note: This holds dimensionless shape, not either physical rate or physical Gaussian scale.

statement: Given a differentiable continuous compactification of the actual EMG profile, an interior stationary value reaching both endpoints is equivalent to a joint finite maximizer. The endpoints may tie the finite fit.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℝ} (hx : LocationScale.Nonconstant x) {P : ℝ → ℝ} (hP : ContinuousOn P (Icc 0 1)) (hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ P (Ioo 0 1)) (hprofile : EqOn P (interiorProfile x) (Ioo 0 1)) : (∃ t ∈ Ioo 0 1, HasDerivAt P 0 t ∧ max (P 0) (P 1) ≤ P t) ↔ ∃ q ∈ (Ioo 0 1 ×ˢ LocationScale.domain), IsMaxOn (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦ shapeLogLik x ((1-p.1)/p.1) p.2) (Ioo 0 1 ×ˢ LocationScale.domain) q
dossier_scope_note: Requires a named hypothesis hprofile identifying the actual profiled likelihood, plus continuity of P on the closed chart and differentiability on its interior. It does not establish face identification for this joint profile or finiteness of stationary shapes.

statement: The held-location log-scale score strictly decreases unless all residuals vanish.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} {r : Fin n → ℝ} (hr : ∃ i, r i ≠ 0) : StrictAntiOn (scaleScore r) (Ioi 0)

statement: The scale score is the derivative in log scale of the actual likelihood.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (r : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun y ↦ logLik r (exp y)) (scaleScore r (exp t)) t

statement: The log-scale score tends to the collapse exponent and to minus the sample size at the two ends of the log-scale line.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (r : Fin n → ℝ) : Tendsto (fun t ↦ scaleScore r (exp t)) atBot (𝓝 ((n : ℝ) - 2 * ties r)) ∧ Tendsto (fun t ↦ scaleScore r (exp t)) atTop (𝓝 (-(n : ℝ)))

statement: At held centre, the unique scale maximizer exists exactly when fewer than half the observations are tied there.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) : (∃ s ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn (logLik r) (Ioi 0) s) ↔ 2 * ties r < n

statement: In the attained regime the maximizing scale is unique and is exactly the positive zero of the scale score.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) (he : 2 * ties r < n) : (∃! s, s ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∧ IsMaxOn (logLik r) (Ioi 0) s) ∧ ∀ s > 0, IsMaxOn (logLik r) (Ioi 0) s ↔ scaleScore r s = 0

statement: A strict majority at the held location sends the log likelihood to positive infinity as scale tends to zero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (r : Fin n → ℝ) (he : n < 2 * ties r) : Tendsto (logLik r) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop

statement: A half tie at the held location gives the finite, unattained scale-zero log-likelihood supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) (he : n = 2 * ties r) : Tendsto (logLik r) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (collapseLog r)) ∧ IsLUB (logLik r '' Ioi 0) (collapseLog r) ∧ ∀ s > 0, logLik r s < collapseLog r

statement: The vertical half-tie path pairs each tied observation with one nonzero residual and converges to the product of the cancelled factors.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {k : ℕ} (d : Fin k → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) : Tendsto (fun s ↦ ∏ i, density 0 s * density (d i) s) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∏ i, (1 / sqrt (2 * π))^2 / (2*(d i)^2)))

statement: On the held-centre half-tie slice every positive scale is strictly below the vertical trace, stated using the normalized likelihood.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (d : Fin k → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : (∏ i, density 0 s * density (d i) s) < ∏ i, (1 / sqrt (2 * π))^2 / (2*(d i)^2)

statement: The corrected opposite-pair inequality holds at every finite centre and positive scale.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {d s : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hs : 0 < s) (m : ℝ) : pairedBlock d m s < pairedTrace d

statement: If every off-point residual is paired with its opposite and each such pair has two tied observations, the vertical limit is the strict global supremum over all centres and positive scales.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (d : Fin k → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i) : IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ i, pairedBlock (d i) p.1 p.2) '' (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0)) (∏ i, pairedTrace (d i)) ∧ ∀ m s : ℝ, 0 < s → (∏ i, pairedBlock (d i) m s) < ∏ i, pairedTrace (d i)
dossier_scope_note: Exact opposite-pair blocks with two tied observations per pair. The proof uses the corrected three-region bound.

statement: Every feasible location below the sample minimum is strictly worse at the same positive scale and held positive shape.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} {ν s : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) : ∃! μ, μ ∈ {m | ∀ j, m ≤ x j} ∧ IsMaxOn (fun m ↦ logLik x m ν s) {m | ∀ j, m ≤ x j} μ

statement: The held-endpoint scale maximum exists exactly at positive collapse exponent and is then unique. Support compatibility is imposed separately.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) : (∃! s, s ∈ Ioi 0 ∧ IsMaxOn (logLik x μ ν) (Ioi 0) s) ↔ 0 < TDist.exponent x μ ν
dossier_scope_note: The scale slice is the half-Student likelihood at a compatible held endpoint. The theorem includes all-tied nonempty samples.

statement: With free endpoint and held shape, the exact existence criterion uses the multiplicity at the sample minimum. Every attained fit is unique.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hm : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) : (∃! p : ℝ × ℝ, p ∈ {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 0 < p.2} ∧ IsMaxOn (fun p ↦ logLik x p.1 ν p.2) {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 0 < p.2} p) ↔ 0 < TDist.exponent x (x i) ν

statement: At critical equality, the half-Student likelihood has a finite unattained supremum along the positive-scale slice.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (he : TDist.exponent x μ ν = 0) : Tendsto (likelihood x μ ν) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (collapseValue x μ ν)) ∧ IsLUB (likelihood x μ ν '' Ioi 0) (collapseValue x μ ν) ∧ ∀ a > 0, likelihood x μ ν a < collapseValue x μ ν

statement: At critical equality, the same finite unattained supremum holds with the endpoint free on its compatible domain.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hm : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) (he : TDist.exponent x (x i) ν = 0) : IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 ν p.2) '' {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 0 < p.2}) (collapseValue x (x i) ν) ∧ ∀ μ s : ℝ, (∀ j, μ ≤ x j) → 0 < s → likelihood x μ ν s < collapseValue x (x i) ν

statement: At negative exponent, the normalized likelihood diverges as scale tends to zero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (he : TDist.exponent x μ ν < 0) : Tendsto (likelihood x μ ν) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop

statement: With a compatible held endpoint and any endpoint tie, there is a positive shape at which the scale-collapse path diverges.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (htie : 0 < TDist.multiplicity x μ) : ∃ ν > 0, Tendsto (likelihood x μ ν) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop

statement: At the fitted shape floor one, a strict majority at the sample minimum makes the all-free likelihood unbounded.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (h : n < 2 * TDist.multiplicity x (x i)) : Tendsto (likelihood x (x i) 1) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop

statement: In the fitted all-free shape range, a sub-half endpoint tie has an attained scale profile at the floor and at every larger shape. An exact half tie has an attained profile at every shape strictly above the floor.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hm : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 1 ≤ ν) (hcount : 2 * TDist.multiplicity x (x i) ≤ n) (hstrict : 1 < ν ∨ 2 * TDist.multiplicity x (x i) < n) : ∃! p : ℝ × ℝ, p ∈ {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 0 < p.2} ∧ IsMaxOn (fun p ↦ logLik x p.1 ν p.2) {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 0 < p.2} p

statement: At fixed compatible endpoint and positive scale, the half-Student likelihood approaches the translated half-normal likelihood as shape tends to infinity.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : Tendsto (fun ν ↦ likelihood x μ ν s) atTop (𝓝 (∏ i, 2*φ ((x i-μ)/s)/s))
dossier_scope_note: Compatible held endpoint and fixed positive scale. The optimized limit is profiled_half_normal_limit.

statement: Any eventually positive sequence of exact held-shape scale roots tends to the Gaussian RMS scale as the degrees of freedom tend to infinity.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (hx : ∃ i, x i ≠ μ) {s : ℝ → ℝ} (hroot : ∀ᶠ ν in atTop, 0 < s ν ∧ TDist.scaleScore x μ ν (s ν) = 0) : Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 (rmsScale x μ))

statement: At a compatible endpoint with a nonzero residual, the optimized scale profile reaches the half-normal value at the endpoint RMS scale.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (hx : ∃ i, x i ≠ μ) : Tendsto (scaleProfile x μ) atTop (𝓝 (∏ i, 2*φ ((x i-μ)/rmsScale x μ)/rmsScale x μ))

statement: At an exact half tie, the optimized scale profile approaches the Cauchy-floor scale-zero value as shape decreases to one from above.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (hx : ∃ i, x i ≠ μ) (he : TDist.exponent x μ 1 = 0) : Tendsto (scaleProfile x μ) (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (collapseValue x μ 1))

statement: At any positive shape the free-endpoint profile has the same upper bounds as the scale profile at the sample minimum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hm : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) : upperBounds ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 ν p.2) '' {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 0 < p.2}) = upperBounds (likelihood x (x i) ν '' Ioi 0)

statement: In the fitted all-free domain, a strict majority at the sample minimum gives an unbounded likelihood.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hm : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) (h : n < 2 * TDist.multiplicity x (x i)) : ¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) '' {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 1 ≤ p.2.1 ∧ 0 < p.2.2})

statement: The exact positive-scale profile is continuous at every positive shape with positive collapse exponent.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (hx : ∃ i, x i ≠ μ) {ν₀ : ℝ} (hν₀ : 0 < ν₀) (he₀ : 0 < TDist.exponent x μ ν₀) : ContinuousAt (scaleProfile x μ) ν₀

statement: Below or at a half tie, a finite fit in the all-free domain exists exactly when an eligible finite shape reaches both excluded face values.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hm : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) (hcount : 2 * TDist.multiplicity x (x i) ≤ n) : (∃ p ∈ {p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 1 ≤ p.2.1 ∧ 0 < p.2.2}, IsMaxOn (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 1 ≤ p.2.1 ∧ 0 < p.2.2} p) ↔ ∃ ν ≥ (1 : ℝ), 0 < TDist.exponent x (x i) ν ∧ max (normalFace x (x i)) (collapseFace x (x i)) ≤ scaleProfile x (x i) ν
dossier_scope_note: Nonmajority minimum ties and fitted shape at least one. The finite-witness comparison does not assert stationary-list finiteness.
